verdict.rationale: Bruno's CLI can run whole collections in one command, including in Docker and CI pipelines, and the docs mention automated data-driven test runs. That is a genuine batch execution capability across many requests. However, no bulk management operation such as editing, moving, deleting or updating many requests at once is documented. Agents editing plain-text collection files would be a user-side workaround, not a product capability. missing for 10: documented bulk edit/update/delete of many requests or variables at once, depth of the data-driven iteration feature, independent or hands-on corroboration of batch runs.
